crew.original_title: ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ
crew.overview: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.
crew.title: Shutter

also_known_as: ลี ชาตะเมธีกุล
details.biography: Lee Chatametikool is a Thai film editor and sound editor. He is a frequent collaborator with Apichatpong Weerasethakul and other Thai independent directors, but has also worked on commercial films, including the hit Thai horror film, Shutter. Lee studied filmmaking in the United States.
details.name: Lee Chatametikool
